tools.name: check_dependency_license
tools.description: Determine whether adding or keeping a single open source dependency creates a legal obligation, given how this project ships. Call this BEFORE adding a new dependency to a project, and when auditing an existing one. A permissive result means no source-disclosure duty; a blocked result means the lice

tools.name: check_manifest_licenses
tools.description: Scan an entire dependency manifest and report every dependency whose license creates an obligation for this shipping model. Use when reviewing a project as a whole, preparing for due diligence, or after a large dependency change. Pass a package-lock.json when one exists: problematic licenses usually

tools.name: explain_license
tools.description: Given an SPDX license identifier or expression, explain what it requires across every shipping model at once.
